name: Black Kiergo Arena
summary: The Black Kiergo Arena is an underground fighting ring in the outlaws refuge beneath Senchal. Caska the Unconquered was the 11-time undefeated champion of the arena before she retired to join Za'ji's crew. Do'mazir the Deadly and Jiren-dar are the current champions. Shirnama, a high-ranking member of the Order of the New Moon, is currently present, scoping out the arena for potential new recruits, and will provide guest commentary during your time here.
notes: Black Kiergo: Primed for Peryite? talks about the history of the location.
The friendly NPCs in the starting bar area lack nameplates.
